description: Inline-image case 5: inline PNG 120x40 (141 bytes) with a valid unique Content-ID that no HTML references (signature removed, image part left behind) -> possible KYC (C-RED-0 3 b / B.4). Investor cannot log in to the portal -> account_access_info.
notes: Attachment 0 (image001.png) is byte-identical to the exempt logo in E0900 and passes B.2, B.3, B.5 and B.6, but the only HTML part has no at all, so condition b fails and the image stays possible KYC. Body avoids change/new/update words, so no bank_details rule label despite 'link'/'password'. No bank line for NW-006.
